assertions.claim: Chest pressure/tightness/pain lasting over 15 minutes unrelieved → call 120.
assertions.cn_span: 超过 15 分钟不缓解，打 120

assertions.claim: Door-to-balloon ≤55 min: 30-day mortality 2.8% (5/178); >55 min: 9.7% (15/155) — Israeli national ACS survey, STEMI.
assertions.cn_span: 到院后 55 分钟内做上球囊扩张的，30 天内死亡 2.8%，超过 55 分钟的 9.7%

assertions.claim: Don't drive yourself; losing consciousness on the road is a second accident.
assertions.cn_span: 别自己开车，路上失去意识就是第二场事故

assertions.claim: In diabetics and the elderly pain may be absent, only shortness of breath; pain can masquerade as abdominal/back/jaw pain or left-arm numbness.
assertions.cn_span: 糖尿病人和老年人可能不痛只喘
